note: Slice result: most concert-étude and caprice sets named in the brief are already in other researchers' files (Lipiński, Kalliwoda, Pichl, Duranowski, Kaczkowski, Kontski Op. 16, Saint-Lubin, Laub Op. 13, Sivori Op. 25, Bazzini Op. 49, Marteau Op. 25, Nováček Op. 5, Martinů H. 202, Hindemith, Bacewicz, Mayseder Op. 29, Monasterio, Campagnoli Op. 12, Libon, Prume, Ghys, Petri, Knox) or in the catalogue (Sciarrino, Eckhardt-Gramatté, O'Connor, Corigliano, Szymanowski Op. 40, Auerbach Op. 46, Bartók 44 Duos, Reger, Kreisler, Strauss, Ysaÿe). New here: 13 entries = 7 books from the 20th/21st century (Widmann Books 1-2, Sher, Minsky, Zámečník, Coult, Szałowski) and 6 solo-caprice sets known only from IMSLP scans (Bohrer, Maurer, Praeger, Eliason, Dworzak von Walden, Troupenas; confidence low, levels estimated by genre; german_a/german_b/franco_b skipped the same kind of obscure sets, Praeger is also in world_other). american_modern skipped Minsky as a cello arrangement; I kept it because OUP issues it as a violin book and RCM lists it. Checked without result: Joachim (only a single 'Capriccio'), J. Böhm (variations and a polonaise only), Ernst (only the 6 études à plusieurs parties, 1864), Vieuxtemps (Op. 16, 48 only; Op. 55 is a set of pieces), Franz Ries, Suk, Laub (no études under the IMSLP category); no violin study books found for Krenek, Veress, Enescu, Blacher, Fortner, Gubaidulina, Ewazen, Bolcom, Schoenfield; Davidoff is a cellist. Not independently checked: Barlowe (id 603), Christoskov (608, 609), Cage (605; Wikipedia: Books I-II = Études 1-16, III-IV = 17-32), Rochberg (655), Elgar Op. 24 (2434; not found on IMSLP under that title). Checked and fine: José White Op. 13 (id 666: IMSLP '6 Études, Op.13', solo violin, 1869; franco_b also lists Op. 33 'Nouvelles études') and Auer Op. 9 (id 2277: Carl Fischer 1924, 'in form of melodic studies'). Overlaps for the owner: Mayseder Op. 29 (central_european, german_a, german_b), Marteau Op. 25 (franco_b, german_b), Kreisler's Study on a Choral (german_b lists it as new but it is id 2595). Not found: Weiner's 13 Caprices (Wikipedia only), Ghertovici, Flury's 10 Capricen, Flausino Vale's 26 Prelúdios (Brazil, not on IMSLP; Latin slice). Used 10 web searches.
